title: The Lost Commit
description: An important commit containing recovery-note.txt disappeared after a reset.
mission: Find the lost commit and make it reachable from a branch or the current branch again.
success: The recovery note is present in reachable Git history again.
hints: Git often retains a record of recent HEAD movements.
Inspect the reflog to find the commit before the reset.
Create a branch at the recovered commit, or cherry-pick that commit onto main.
